DECISIONS:

RATIONALE:
Q1: This heal issue cannot change `docs/INVENTORY.md`, and options A and B do not get around that. The frozen marker allows only `.github/workflows/ci.yml,tests/**,changelog.d/*.md`. A plan that names `docs/INVENTORY.md` is held as `heal_scope_plan_out_of_scope` (see `run_heal_plan_scope_gate` in `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py` and the hold text in `.github/workflows/plan.yml`). Implementation enforces the marker even after approval (`agents.md` L2212). For that case the repo's own route is to fix the defect outside the heal pipeline. A and B also rely on the pipeline filing a new issue and closing this one, which the planner and implementer cannot do (they only change files and open one PR). B's `HEAL_SCOPE_GUARD_TEST_SUBJECTS` change edits `scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py`, which is also outside this scope. C is the only option that can actually land.

To make the operator step a copy-and-paste, the planner should list `docs/INVENTORY.md` as the only file to change and spell out the exact edit. Add these two bullets in the Scripts section right after the `scripts/review_freshness_ci_failed.sh` entry (currently line 304), worded as in the issue's "Suggested fix":
- `` - `scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh` — Marks a PR head whose final CI run failed (`ai:final-ci-failed:v1`) and dispatches the PR's review workflow so autofix can fix the failing checks; run from the `final-ci-failed` job of `ci.yml`. ``
- `` - `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh` — Review-sweep safety net that hands PR heads with a successful `ai-review/head-gate` but no final CI run to `_pr_ensure_final_ci`. ``

`docs/INVENTORY.md` on this checkout still has no `review_final_ci_` entry, so the gap is real.

The plan must not touch:
- `tests/inventory_parity.py`, which must not be weakened;
- `tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py`, which is already fixed on `main`;
- the scripts themselves, or their references in `README.md` / `agents.md`.

Running `python3 tests/inventory_parity.py` on `main` is the acceptance check, and it should pass once the two entries exist.

The plan gate will hold the plan as `heal_scope_plan_out_of_scope`. That hold is expected: it is how the repo hands an out-of-scope fix to a maintainer. Mapping `tests/inventory_parity.py` to `docs/INVENTORY.md` so future heals of this kind get a usable scope is out of scope here.
